item.text:
Implemented `out/transform.ts`. The harness and 21 edge-case tests pass.

Judgment calls: discharge lists take precedence within an encounter; discouraged restart still means “held.” Unstated onset/start dates remain omitted. Drug-class attribution stays at class level, and distinct Riverside diagnoses remain separate despite shared ICD codes.
